summary: 6 acceptance criteria exercised via 2 backend test files + 2 browser checks. All passed.

checks.name: test_daily_reset_archives_and_cancels_open_ticket_and_report_still_counts (part 1)
checks.evidence: POST /api/orders created fixture; backdated created_at before local midnight in Mongo; ran _daily_reset(force=True) in-process; GET /api/orders 200 no longer includes the ticket's id; Mongo doc shows archived=true.

checks.criterion: Open yesterday tickets are cancelled, not left hanging
checks.name: test_daily_reset_archives_and_cancels_open_ticket_and_report_still_counts (part 2)
checks.evidence: Order backdated with status=pay_now; after _daily_reset(force=True), Mongo doc status == 'cancelled' and archived == true (assertion passed).

checks.criterion: Archived tickets still count in sales history
checks.name: test_daily_reset_archives_and_cancels_open_ticket_and_report_still_counts (part 3)
checks.evidence: GET /api/reports/daily?date=<yesterday> baseline vs after archiving a backdated 'served' order: order_count increased by >=1 and revenue increased by the order's total ($20.00); backend/backend/tests/test_tscheck_daily_reset_archive.py::test_... PASSED.

checks.name: test_cron_daily_reset_requires_auth / test_cron_daily_reset_accepts_valid_secret
checks.evidence: POST /api/cron/daily-reset (no auth) -> 401. POST /api/cron/daily-reset with 'Authorization: Bearer <WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET>' -> 200 {"accepted": true}. tests/test_tscheck_cron_auth.py 2 passed.

checks.criterion: Customer order flow still works end to end
checks.name: customer-order-flow-e2e
checks.evidence: Ran against https://dine-scan-22.preview.emergentagent.com (APP_URL): Home -> Start order -> Food -> add item -> cart -> name 'tscheck-cust-<ts>' -> Send to kitchen -> tracker shows order-code, status-tracker, order-status-badge, and matching customer name. No response >=400 observed.

checks.criterion: Staff board and ping alerts still work
checks.name: staff-board-ping-alerts
checks.evidence: Localhost:3000, mobile viewport 390x844. Customer placed order 'tscheck-ping-<ts>'; staff tab unlocked with PIN 2006, ticket visible on board with matching name; PING advanced received->pay_now, customer tracker showed flashing overlay heading 'PLEASE COME PAY NOW', dismissed via 'On my way' button, overlay closed; staff advanced pay_now->preparing->ready, customer tracker showed flashing overlay heading 'YOUR ORDER IS READY', dismissed successfully.
